metrics.label: Bitcoin price
metrics.description: Daily reference price in US dollars.
metrics.methodology: Daily reference price in US dollars.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Market capitalisation
metrics.description: Daily USD reference price multiplied by the reported circulating BTC supply.
metrics.methodology: Daily USD reference price multiplied by the reported circulating BTC supply.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Realised capitalisation
metrics.description: Market capitalisation divided by imported Coin Metrics MVRV. This is an algebraic derivation, not an independent recalculation of the UTXO set.
metrics.methodology: Market capitalisation divided by imported Coin Metrics MVRV. This is an algebraic derivation, not an independent recalculation of the UTXO set.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Reported spot trading volume
metrics.description: Reported spot volume aggregated by Coin Metrics. This is not guaranteed to be adjusted or to cover the entire market.
metrics.methodology: Reported spot volume aggregated by Coin Metrics. This is not guaranteed to be adjusted or to cover the entire market.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: MVRV ratio
metrics.description: Market capitalisation divided by realised capitalisation.
metrics.methodology: Market capitalisation divided by realised capitalisation.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Puell Multiple
metrics.description: Daily USD value of newly issued BTC divided by its 365-day moving average.
metrics.methodology: Daily USD value of newly issued BTC divided by its 365-day moving average.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.description: Percentage price change over 30 calendar days.
metrics.methodology: Percentage price change over 30 calendar days.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 1-year return

metrics.label: 30-day volatility
metrics.description: Annualised standard deviation of daily logarithmic returns over 30 days.
metrics.methodology: Annualised standard deviation of daily logarithmic returns over 30 days.

metrics.methodology: Annualised standard deviation of daily logarithmic returns over 90 days.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Drawdown from all-time high

metrics.label: Transactions per day
metrics.description: Confirmed transactions per UTC day.
metrics.methodology: Confirmed transactions per UTC day.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Active addresses
metrics.description: Addresses with observed activity. Addresses are not unique people.
metrics.methodology: Addresses with observed activity. Addresses are not unique people.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: UTXO count
metrics.description: Spendable UTXOs after the last block assigned to the UTC day. The value is undefined on days without a block. The separate Firsthand Bitcoin daily series also counts unspent transaction outputs, but differs from Open Bitcoin Metrics and is not mixed into the main series. Firsthand permits use with a source link.
metrics.methodology: Spendable UTXOs after the last block assigned to the UTC day. The value is undefined on days without a block. The separate Firsthand Bitcoin daily series also counts unspent transaction outputs, but differs from Open Bitcoin Metrics and is not mixed into the main series. Firsthand permits use with a source link.
metrics.sourceHint: Open Bitcoin Metrics (OBM)

metrics.label: Block weight
metrics.description: Total block weight per UTC day. OBM weight units are converted from WU to MWU.
metrics.methodology: Total block weight per UTC day. OBM weight units are converted from WU to MWU.
metrics.sourceHint: Open Bitcoin Metrics (OBM)

metrics.label: Circulating supply
metrics.description: Bitcoin created by the end of the day, adjusted for documented special cases according to the source methodology.
metrics.methodology: Bitcoin created by the end of the day, adjusted for documented special cases according to the source methodology.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Newly issued Bitcoin
metrics.description: Total consensus-valid block subsidies per UTC day, calculated across the 210,000-block halving boundaries and historically reconciled with Coin Metrics IssTotNtv.
metrics.methodology: Total consensus-valid block subsidies per UTC day, calculated across the 210,000-block halving boundaries and historically reconciled with Coin Metrics IssTotNtv.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Supply inflation
metrics.description: Annualised new issuance relative to circulating supply.
metrics.methodology: Annualised new issuance relative to circulating supply.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Exchange balances
metrics.description: Estimated BTC balances of known exchange addresses.
metrics.methodology: Estimated BTC balances of known exchange addresses.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Exchange net flow
metrics.description: Deposits minus withdrawals for known exchange addresses.
metrics.methodology: Deposits minus withdrawals for known exchange addresses.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Estimated hashrate
metrics.description: Computing power estimated from block intervals and mining difficulty.
metrics.methodology: Computing power estimated from block intervals and mining difficulty.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: End-of-day mining difficulty
metrics.description: Difficulty of the highest block whose timestamp falls within the UTC day. This is the OBM end-of-day value; the earlier daily-average estimate remains separately archived. Undefined days are left empty.
metrics.methodology: Difficulty of the highest block whose timestamp falls within the UTC day. This is the OBM end-of-day value; the earlier daily-average estimate remains separately archived. Undefined days are left empty.

metrics.label: Blocks per day
metrics.description: Confirmed blocks per UTC day.
metrics.methodology: Confirmed blocks per UTC day.

metrics.label: Miner revenue

metrics.label: Hashprice
metrics.description: Estimated revenue per petahash per day, according to the documented methodology.
metrics.methodology: Estimated revenue per petahash per day, according to the documented methodology.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Total transaction fees
metrics.description: Total fees of all confirmed transactions per day.
metrics.methodology: Total fees of all confirmed transactions per day.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Average transaction fee
metrics.description: Total transaction fees divided by confirmed transactions, in USD.
metrics.methodology: Total transaction fees divided by confirmed transactions, in USD.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: CFTC Bitcoin futures open interest
metrics.description: Estimated USD notional value of CBOE/CME Bitcoin futures reported by the CFTC. Observations follow the weekly report date; this is not daily global open interest.
metrics.methodology: Estimated USD notional value of CBOE/CME Bitcoin futures reported by the CFTC. Observations follow the weekly report date; this is not daily global open interest.

metrics.label: Fear & Greed Index
metrics.description: Daily Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index, from 0 to 100. Direct history starts in February 2018; missing days remain empty. Earlier OpenBitcoin values remain in a separate archived series.
metrics.methodology: Daily Alternative.me Fear & Greed Index, from 0 to 100. Direct history starts in February 2018; missing days remain empty. Earlier OpenBitcoin values remain in a separate archived series.

metrics.label: Realised price
metrics.description: Realised capitalisation divided by circulating supply.
metrics.methodology: Realised capitalisation divided by circulating supply.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Net unrealised profit/loss
metrics.description: Market capitalisation minus realised capitalisation, divided by market capitalisation.
metrics.methodology: Market capitalisation minus realised capitalisation, divided by market capitalisation.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 200-day average price
metrics.description: Rolling arithmetic mean of the last 200 daily prices.
metrics.methodology: Rolling arithmetic mean of the last 200 daily prices.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Mayer Multiple
metrics.description: Daily price divided by its 200-day moving average.
metrics.methodology: Daily price divided by its 200-day moving average.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 90-day return
metrics.description: Price change from the price 90 calendar days earlier.
metrics.methodology: Price change from the price 90 calendar days earlier.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 3-year annualised return
metrics.description: Geometrically annualised return between the daily price and the price on the corresponding calendar date three years earlier.
metrics.methodology: Geometrically annualised return between the daily price and the price on the corresponding calendar date three years earlier.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Coin days destroyed
metrics.description: Sum of the BTC value of each spent output multiplied by its age in days. This is an unadjusted on-chain series.
metrics.methodology: Sum of the BTC value of each spent output multiplied by its age in days. This is an unadjusted on-chain series.
metrics.sourceHint: Open Bitcoin Metrics (OBM)

metrics.label: Blocks until next halving
metrics.description: Blocks remaining until the next subsidy halving under the Bitcoin protocol rules.
metrics.methodology: Blocks remaining until the next subsidy halving under the Bitcoin protocol rules.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 7-day block interval
metrics.description: Mean interval between confirmed blocks over a rolling seven-day window.
metrics.methodology: Mean interval between confirmed blocks over a rolling seven-day window.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Addresses with a balance
metrics.description: Daily count of Bitcoin addresses with a positive balance. An address is not a person, and the measure does not adjust for the splitting of a wallet across addresses.
metrics.methodology: Daily count of Bitcoin addresses with a positive balance. An address is not a person, and the measure does not adjust for the splitting of a wallet across addresses.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Exchange inflow
metrics.description: Daily BTC inflow to exchange addresses identified by Coin Metrics. Address-label coverage and methodology may change.
metrics.methodology: Daily BTC inflow to exchange addresses identified by Coin Metrics. Address-label coverage and methodology may change.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Exchange outflow
metrics.description: Daily BTC outflow from identified exchange addresses. Address-label coverage and methodology may change.
metrics.methodology: Daily BTC outflow from identified exchange addresses. Address-label coverage and methodology may change.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Year-to-date return
metrics.description: Price change from the last available price at the end of the previous year.
metrics.methodology: Price change from the last available price at the end of the previous year.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: 200-week average price
metrics.description: Arithmetic mean of the last 200 Sunday closing prices. Published once per week after a complete observation window is available.
metrics.methodology: Arithmetic mean of the last 200 Sunday closing prices. Published once per week after a complete observation window is available.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations

metrics.label: Liveliness
metrics.description: Cumulative coin days destroyed divided by cumulative coin days created, using the OBM definition.
metrics.methodology: Cumulative coin days destroyed divided by cumulative coin days created, using the OBM definition.
metrics.sourceHint: Open Bitcoin Metrics (OBM)

metrics.label: Blockspace utilisation
metrics.description: Daily total block weight divided by the block count and the Bitcoin consensus limit of four million WU per block. Measures average utilisation per block and is undefined without confirmed blocks.
metrics.methodology: Daily total block weight divided by the block count and the Bitcoin consensus limit of four million WU per block. Measures average utilisation per block and is undefined without confirmed blocks.
metrics.sourceHint: Coin Metrics and documented Bitcoin calculations
